56:17.text: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.

56:18.text: With vessels, pitchers and a cup

56:19.text: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

56:20.text: And fruit of what they select

56:21.text: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

56:24.text: As reward for what they used to do.

56:25.text: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

56:27.text: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

56:28.text: among lote trees with thorns removed.

56:38.text: For the companions of the right

56:39.text: A company of the former peoples

56:40.text: And a company of the later peoples.

56:41.text: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

56:42.text: in scorching fire and scalding water

56:43.text: And a shade of black smoke,

56:45.text: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

56:46.text: And they used to persist in the great violation,

56:47.text: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

56:50.text: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
